product.name: ChemGuard 500ml Safety Flask
product.description: ChemGuard 500ml Safety Flask is a robust containment vessel designed for laboratory chemical storage and transport. Constructed from high-grade stainless steel, the flask features a double-walled construction that provides thermal insulation and reduces condensation. A silicone gasket seals the threaded cap, ensuring leak-free operation even under moderate pressure. The 500 ml capacity is ideal for handling acids, bases, or solvents in routine experiments. The flask’s ergonomic handle and matte finish enhance safety during handling. It is compatible with standard 15 mm threaded caps and standard lab safety cabinets. The ChemGuard 500ml Safety Flask offers a reliable solution for chemists seeking durable, easy-to-clean storage containers.
